atoms.description: Predictor incorrectly blocks loading a second crate into a truck.
atoms.name: single_cargo

atoms.description: Predictor incorrectly blocks dropping a crate onto another crate.
atoms.name: no_stacking

depot.goal: Arrange every crate so that all goal facts hold.
depot.rules: Standard Depot PDDL: clear-stack lifting, one crate per hoist, load/unload at the truck's place.

atoms.description: A launched crate that really slides 2+ cells and stops at a wall or another crate is predicted to stop one cell earlier, hiding crates that reach walls and corners.
atoms.name: crate_stops_early

atoms.description: A launched crate that really stops on a type R tile is predicted to slide on as if the tile were plain floor.
atoms.name: crate_slides_past_rough

atoms.description: A crate launched up or down into an empty socket is predicted to stop there loose instead of being fixed.
atoms.name: socket_vertical_no_capture

iceslide.goal: Get every crate into a socket.
iceslide.rules: The agent slides until the next cell is a wall or crate, or it enters a type R tile. If its slide is stopped by a loose crate (and it is not on type R), the crate is launched and slides until blocked, entering type R, or entering an empty socket, where it is fixed forever.

atoms.description: Ending a step orthogonally adjacent to a guard is predicted as a capture (the real rule needs the same cell).
atoms.name: adjacent_capture

patrol.goal: Reach the exit cell without being caught.
patrol.rules: One cell per action or wait. After the agent moves, each guard advances one step along a fixed hidden back-and-forth route. Ending on a guard's cell or swapping with a guard is capture (failure).

atoms.description: A locked door is predicted to open while an unrelated key is held.
atoms.name: door_wrong_key

atoms.description: A safe pad is predicted to lead to a pad that links into it.
atoms.name: reverse_portal

portalmaze.rules: Walls block movement. A door is impassable until the agent has picked up the key of the same letter; keys are picked up by stepping on them and are never consumed. Every pad teleports the agent, on stepping onto it, to a fixed hidden destination pad (links may be one-way). Arriving on a destination pad does not trigger it; the agent must step off and back on. One pad leads one-way into a sealed pocket of two pads that link only to each other, an irreversible trap. Success on reaching the exit; no terminal failure.

actions: move_to <x> <y>: absolute pusher target in pixels, coordinates in [0, 512]; held for 4 control steps; arrival is not guaranteed

atoms.description: The predictor moves the pusher 80% of the requested target displacement.
atoms.name: target_gain

pusht.goal: Push the T-shaped block so that it overlaps the goal pose by more than 95%.
pusht.rules: 2D rigid-body pushing (pymunk): a circular pusher under PD control pushes a T block with friction-free planar contact.

atoms.description: After a context cue, a breaker is predicted to disable a different enabled button.
atoms.name: breaker_retarget_enabled

switchboard.goal: Turn on every lamp on the panel.
switchboard.rules: Each numbered button toggles a fixed hidden subset of lamps (subsets may overlap). Some buttons are breakers: pressing one also permanently disables one specific other button (hidden until it happens). Pressing a disabled button does nothing but still costs the action. Success when all lamps are on; there is no terminal failure, but disabling a button that is needed can make the task unsolvable.
